items.title: Tata Motors PV eyes reigniting India’s hatchback market with new Tiago
items.summary: The automaker believes that feature-rich upgrades and multiple powertrain options can help hatchbacks regain appeal among first-time car buyers amid the growing dominance of SUVs.

items.summary: Taiwanese battery maker ProLogium Technology is set to go public in New York via a $3.8 billion merger with Translational Development Acquisition Corp.

items.title: ‘Even budget car buyers have premium expectations’: Tata Motors' Martin Uhlarik
items.summary: As Tata Motors refreshes the Tiago amid a shrinking hatchback market, Tata Motors' Global Design Head Martin Uhlarik tells ETAuto why affordability no longer means compromising on aspiration. In this exclusive conversation, he discusses Tata’s evolving design philosophy, rising demand for premium interiors in budget cars, and how EVs are moving into the mainstream.

items.title: Ferrari aims to prove doubters wrong after divisive EV debut
items.summary: Ferrari's first all-electric car, the Luce, has sparked global shock and outrage with its departure from the brand's traditional sports car image. The four-door, five-seat family car, designed by Jony Ive and Marc Newson, has drawn widespread criticism and a significant drop in Ferrari's stock price.

items.title: Auto demand healthy despite rise in input costs: Nirmal Minda
items.summary: He also expressed optimism about the electric vehicle transition, while cautioning that charging infrastructure remained a major bottleneck, particularly outside metros. EV adoption in the two-wheeler segment is progressing faster because home charging is easier to manage.

items.title: Bosch’s India Recast
items.summary: On May 21, 2026, the German engineering giant Bosch Ltd announced a 50:50 joint venture with the TSF Group’s Brakes India and Wheels India. While the deal might appear to be a localized expansion of air systems for commercial vehicles (CVs), it serves as a microcosm for a much larger, more aggressive transformation as the automotive industry in India is set to evolve rapidly by 2030 and beyond.

items.title: Atul Auto, Exponent Energy partner to roll out 15-minute charging electric three-wheelers
items.summary: The tie-up will integrate 15-minute rapid charging technology into factory-built vehicles, aiming to accelerate EV adoption in the commercial segment.

items.summary: The new range gets connected features, dual-screen cabin, ADAS-linked safety tech and multiple powertrain options as Tata Motors PV looks to revive hatchback demand amid India’s SUV shift.

items.title: JK Tyre Unveils One Of Its Largest Capex Plans As Capacity Utilisation Crosses 90%
items.summary: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd has announced one of its largest-ever capital expenditure plans, approving a Rs 4,980 crore phased expansion of its truck and passenger car radial tyre capacities amid strong demand across domestic and export markets. The expansion, approved by the company’s board, will increase overall capacity by 24% over the next three years and will primarily focus on the Chennai and Mysore plants.
